findings.message: The audio track 1 holds protected alac (Apple Lossless), whose samples are not analyzed yet.

The audio track 1 is covered by Common Encryption, AES-CTR (cenc), but its key information says that no sample is protected: the tenc box sets the default to not protected, and nothing in the file says otherwise (no sample group that protects, no sample encryption box).
